title: HiChIP: Protein-centric chromatin conformation
protocol: Pellet detached adherent or suspension cells.
Resuspend the cells in freshly made 1% formaldehyde at a volume of 1 mL per one million cells.
Incubate the cells at room temperature with rotation for 10 minutes.
Add glycine to achieve a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes with rotation.
Pellet the cells, wash in PBS, pellet again, and store at -80°C or proceed into the HiChIP protocol.
Resuspend up to 15 million crosslinked cells in 500 μL of ice-cold Hi-C Lysis Buffer and rotate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Spin down the sample at 2500 rcf for 5 minutes, discard the supernatant, and wash pelleted nuclei once with 500 μL of ice-cold Hi-C Lysis Buffer.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of 0.5% SDS.
Incubate at 62°C for 10 minutes, then add 285 μL of H2O and 50 μL of 10% Triton X-100 to quench the SDS.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Add 50 μL of 10X NEB Buffer 2 and 375 U of MboI restriction enzyme, then digest chromatin for 2 hours at 37°C with rotation.
Heat inactivate MboI at 62°C for 20 minutes.
Add 52 μL of fill-in master mix to the reaction mixture.
Mix and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour with rotation.
Prepare ligation master mix by combining 150 μL of 10X NEB T4 DNA ligase buffer, 125 μL of 10% Triton X-100, 3 μL of 50 mg/mL BSA, 10 μL of 400 U/μL T4 DNA Ligase, and 660 μL of water.
Incubate at room temperature for 4 hours with rotation.
Pellet nuclei at 2500 rcf for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant from the pellet.
Bring up the pellet to a total volume of 880 μL in Nuclear Lysis Buffer.
Transfer samples to a Covaris millitube.
Shear using the following parameters: Fill Level = 10, Duty Cycle = 5, PIP = 140, Cycles/Burst = 200, Time = 4 minutes.
Clarify sample for 15 minutes at 16100 rcf at 4 degrees.
Add 2X volume of ChIP Dilution Buffer to the clarified sample \(split into two tubes of ~400 μL each and add 750 μL Dilution Buffer).
Dilute Smc1a antibody \(Bethyl A300-055A) 1:2 in ChIP Dilution Buffer to achieve a SDS concentration of 0.33%.
For other antibodies, dilute the lysate up to 1:9 to achieve a SDS concentration of 0.1%.
Wash 60 μL of Protein A beads for every 10m cells in ChIP Dilution Buffer.
Resuspend Protein A beads in 50 μL of Dilution Buffer per tube, add to sample, and rotate at 4°C for 1 hour.
Put samples on magnet and transfer supernatant into new tubes.
Add 7.5 ug of antibody for every 10m cells and incubate at 4°C overnight with rotation.
Wash 60 μL of Protein A beads for every 10m cells in ChIP Dilution Buffer.
Resuspend Protein A beads in 50 μL of Dilution Buffer, add to sample, and rotate at 4°C for 2 hours.
Wash beads three times each with Low Salt Wash Buffer, High Salt Wash Buffer, and LiCl Wash Buffer.
Resuspend ChIP sample beads in 100 μL of DNA Elution Buffer.
Incubate at RT for 10 minutes with rotation, followed by 3 minutes at 37°C shaking.
Place ChIP samples on magnet and remove supernatant to a fresh tube.
Add another 100 μL of DNA Elution Buffer to ChIP samples and repeat incubations.
Remove ChIP samples supernatant to the new tube, leaving 200 μL of ChIP sample.
Add 10 μL of Proteinase K to each sample.
Incubate at 55°C for 45 minutes with shaking.
Increase temperature to 67°C and incubate for at least 1.5 hours with shaking.
Zymo purify the samples.
Elute purified samples in 10 μL of water.
Quantify post-ChIP DNA to estimate Tn5 needed for library generation.
Prepare for biotin pull-down by washing 5 μL of Streptavidin C-1 beads with Tween Wash Buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 10 μL of 2X Biotin Binding Buffer and add to samples.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes with rotation.
Separate on a magnet and discard supernatant.
Wash the beads twice by adding 500 μL of Tween Wash Buffer.
Incubate at 55°C for 2 minutes shaking.
Wash the beads in 100 μL of 1X TD Buffer.
Resuspend beads in 25 μL of 2X TD Buffer, add the appropriate amount of Tn5 based on post-ChIP DNA amount, and adjust to a total volume of 50 μL with water.
Incubate at 55°C with interval shaking for 10 minutes.
Place samples on magnet and remove supernatant.
Add 50 mM EDTA to samples and incubate at 50°C for 30 minutes, then quickly place on magnet and remove supernatant.
Wash samples twice with 50 mM EDTA at 50°C for 3 minutes, removing quickly on magnet.
Wash samples twice in Tween Wash Buffer at 55°C for 2 minutes, removing quickly on magnet.
Wash samples in 10 mM Tris.
Resuspend beads in 50 μL of PCR master mix: 25 μL Phusion HF 2X, 1 μL Nextera Ad1.1 Universal 12.5 uM, 1 μL Nextera Ad2.x Barcoded 12.5 uM, and 23 μL water.

Run the following PCR program: 5 minutes at 72°C, 1 minute at 98°C, then cycle for 15 seconds at 98°C, 30 seconds at 63°C, and 1 minute at 72°C. Cycle number can be estimated using one of two methods.
First method: Run 5 cycles on a regular PCR and then remove from beads. Add 0.25X SYBR green and run on a qPCR to pull out samples at the beginning of exponential amplification.

Second method: Run reactions on a PCR and estimate cycle number based on the amount of material from the post-ChIP Qubit measurement (greater than 50 ng was ran in five cycles, approximately 50 ng was ran in six, 25 ng was ran in seven, 12.5 ng was ran in eight).
Zymo purify and elute in the same 10 μL of water.

PAGE purify libraries using a 6% gel from a size range of 300 – 700 bp. Note that if the bulk of the material is smaller than these sizes, they can be included but paired-end libraries will have a lower alignment rate. Adjust Tn5 amount accordingly in future experiments.
Place libraries on a magnet after PCR and elute into new tubes.
Add 25 μl of Ampure XP beads to capture fragments less than 700 bp.
Transfer the supernatant containing fragments less than 700 bp to a new tube.
Add 15 μl of fresh Ampure XP beads to capture fragments greater than 300 bp.
Elute purified libraries in 10 μl of water for final quantification with qPCR against Illumina primers and/or Bioanalyzer.
